description: This is a false-colour infrared satellite image showing managed grasslands and agricultural fields in the Hade edge region of the United Kingdom, captured on 2012-01-31. The image uses a 1/2/3 band combination (likely Near Infrared-Red-Green), which renders healthy vegetation in shades of red. The landscape is characterised by numerous irregularly shaped fields, predominantly bright red, indicating extensive areas of managed grasslands. These fields are often delineated by darker, narrow linear features, typical of hedgerows or tree lines forming a 'Hade edge'. Scattered within the agricultural landscape are small clusters of grey/white features with darker roofs, representing farmsteads or small settlements, connected by light-coloured linear features which are roads or paths. A single, distinct green circular marker is centrally located within one of the red-coloured fields. The image was acquired by the Spot 5 satellite at a spatial resolution of 2.5 metres.
